- **Edition labels:** a new page, opened from a button in the panel, that makes labels for your storage boxes. Each label can show the set icon, name and code, plus an optional FOIL mark and condition. Pick sets from your loaded CSV or from all Scryfall sets, check the exact preview and download PNG files or one ZIP for 24 mm tape.
- **Print labels directly to a Brother PT-P710BT over USB** (Chrome, Brave, Edge): print one label or all of them, choose the number of copies and whether the printer cuts after each label. Firefox cannot print over USB, PNG and ZIP export still work there.
- **Stay logged in (optional, off by default):** an open Cardmarket tab loads one Cardmarket page every 30 minutes so your session does not time out.
